      Case 3:26-cv-07926-EMC            Document 21         Filed 08/20/26     Page 2 of 3



 1           Plaintiff Tarra Chamberlain (“Plaintiff”) and Defendant Granola, Inc. (“Defendant”)

 2   (collectively, the “Parties”), by and through their counsel of record, stipulate and agree, as

 3   follows:

 4           WHEREAS, Plaintiff’s Complaint was filed on July 30, 2026;

 5           WHEREAS, on August 5, 2026, Plaintiff served the Summons and Complaint for this

 6   action on Granola, Inc., and pursuant to FRCP 12(a), a response to the Complaint is due on or

 7   before August 26, 2026;

 8           WHEREAS, Granola, Inc. requires time to investigate the allegations in the Complaint

 9   and to meet and confer with Plaintiff regarding the response to the Complaint, and the Parties

10   agree to extend the time for Granola, Inc. to respond to the Complaint in the above-entitled action

11   up to and including October 12, 2026;

12           WHEREAS, Granola Labs Ltd. has not yet been served; and

13           WHEREAS, the Parties have not previously requested any other time modifications in this

14   case, and this stipulated extension will not disrupt deadlines “already fixed by Court order” in the

15   above-entitled action pursuant to Civil Local Rule 6-1(a),

16           NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS HEREBY STIPULATED AND AGREED, by and

17   between the Parties, that Granola, Inc’s deadline to respond to the Complaint shall be October 12,

18   2026.

ORDER REASSIGNING CASE IT IS ORDERED that this case is reassigned using a proportionate, random and blind system pursuant to General Order No. 44 to Judge Edward M Chen. Magistrate Judge Joseph C. Counsel are reminded to verify the location of the judge on the court website. All hearing and trial dates presently scheduled are vacated. However, existing briefing schedules for motions remain unchanged. Motions must be renoticed for hearing before the judge to whom the case has been reassigned, but the renoticing of the hearing does not affect the prior briefing schedule. Other deadlines such as those for ADR compliance and discovery cutoff also remain unchanged. Notice: The assigned judge participates in the Cameras in the Courtroom Pilot Project.
